name: git-mcp
description: git-mcp (cyanheads/git-mcp-server, Apache-2.0) — local git operations (status/diff/log/commit/branch/worktree/tag, GPG/SSH signing) over the system git with validated argv. Local only (net:false), no env secrets (signing uses local keys). Runtime dep: npm i -g @cyanheads/git-mcp-server or npx (or set GIT_MCP_SERVER_BIN).
